info.title: Renga API
info.description: Machine API for collectors. Requests authenticate with an organization intake key and identify the installation with the `x-renga-installation-id` header.

AgentHome.title: AgentHome
AgentHome.description: Where the agent sends every authenticated request.

home.description: The home deployment's origin: an `https` URL with no path, query, or credentials (`http` only for agents configured for insecure development). The agent persists it and resolves again only when its home answers `410` with `moved`.

CheckIn.title: CheckIn
CheckIn.description: A collector's periodic check-in. Every field is optional.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the collector can run now.

items.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

installation_key.description: The installation's public key (RFD 13). Renga records the first key as pending until an owner or admin approves its fingerprint; a different key returns the installation to pending.

public_key.description: The raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key in base64url, normally unpadded (43 characters); a padded key is also accepted.

metadata.description: Agent metadata, stored with the source. Must encode to at most 16000 bytes of JSON.

power_sources.description: Every power source the agent samples and whether it can read it. Omitted until the agent has sampled once; each report replaces the last.

CheckInAccepted.title: CheckInAccepted
CheckInAccepted.description: The check-in was recorded and the collector's lease renewed.

installation_key.description: The key this check-in presented and whether it is approved. Absent when the check-in presented no key.

fingerprint.description: SHA256: and the unpadded base64 digest.

jobs_waiting.description: True when jobs are queued for this installation, so the agent should lease now rather than at its next lease attempt.

HostResource.title: HostResource
HostResource.description: The host as the agent sees it, or for a scoped report a switch (`targets`) or VM (`hypervisor`) a collector reports. Fields the server assigns, such as `id`, are rejected. A switch or VM is matched to inventory only by serial_number, dmi_uuid, machine_id, one of which it must have.

components.description: Hardware components, stored as reported. The agent sends objects with a `kind` discriminator whose other fields depend on the kind.

attributes.description: Descriptive host fields. `hostname` and `fqdn` must match the identifiers of the same name, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace.

domain.description: For a `vm` in a `hypervisor` report only: the hypervisor's own view of the domain. Running, idle, paused, and shutting-down domains occupy the hypervisor; the rest are only defined on it.

disks.description: Block devices by guest target name, such as `vda`.

target.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

interfaces.description: Virtual NICs. MAC addresses are evidence only and never match the VM to a host.

mac_address.description: A MAC address in any common notation.

name.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

identifiers.description: Identifiers used to match the host to inventory. At least one of hostname, fqdn, machine_id, dmi_uuid, serial_number is required. `mac_address` must list exactly the MAC addresses of the present ethernet interfaces.

anyOf.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

items.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

anyOf.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

items.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

fqdn.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

hostname.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

anyOf.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

items.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

anyOf.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

items.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

anyOf.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

items.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

anyOf.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

items.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

interfaces.description: Network interfaces. Names must be unique after trimming.

kind.description: `server` for a host report, `switch` or `vm` for a scoped report.

labels.description: Operator-configured labels from the agent configuration.

target.description: For `targets` scope, required: the address, as a non-blank string, of the reachable target this switch was polled from. Not allowed for `hypervisor` scope, and ignored for `host` scope.

mac_address.description: A MAC address in any common notation.

name.description: Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

neighbors.description: LLDP or CDP neighbors. Each remote endpoint may appear once.

remote_chassis_id.description: Must be a MAC or network address when its kind says so. Must not be blank.

remote_port_id.description: Must be a MAC address when its kind says so. Must not be blank.

relationships.description: Links to other interfaces on this host, never to itself.

target.description: The name of the related interface. Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

routing_domain.description: The source-local routing domain (VRF) this interface belongs to. Null withdraws an earlier claim; omitting it says nothing.

vlans.description: VLAN memberships. At most one may be untagged, `access` mode allows at most one VLAN, and each source-local VLAN may appear once.

key.description: Source-local VLAN identity, at most 2000 bytes and not blank. Defaults to the scope and VID.

JobClaim.title: JobClaim
JobClaim.description: A signed claim of an offered privileged job (RFD 13).

signature.description: The 64-byte Ed25519 signature in base64url, normally unpadded (86 characters); a padded signature is also accepted.

JobLease.title: JobLease
JobLease.description: Jobs leased to the calling installation, possibly none, and privileged jobs offered to it. Each lease lasts until `lease_expires_at`; every newly recorded report extends it.

offers.description: Privileged jobs (RFD 13) the installation may claim by signing for them with its approved installation key. Absent from older servers.

capabilities.description: The `name@version` capabilities the agent will run now. Only jobs for these are leased.

limit.description: The most jobs to lease at once.

JobOffer.title: JobOffer
JobOffer.description: A privileged job (RFD 13) offered to the calling installation. To lease it, sign these lines, each ending in a newline, with the installation key and post the signature to the job's claim endpoint before `expires_at`: `renga-job-lease-v1`, `job_id`, `lease_token`, `nonce`, the installation ID, `resource_id`, and `binding_version`. A later lease request replaces the offer.

binding_version.description: The version of the resource's target binding the job runs under.

lease_token.description: Becomes the lease token once the claim succeeds.

JobReport.title: JobReport
JobReport.description: One numbered report on a leased job. `started` moves the job to running; `progress` and `output` follow while it runs; `succeeded`, `failed`, and `cancelled` finish it, and `cancelled` only after cancellation was requested.

payload.description: Opaque for `started`, `progress`, and `output`. A `succeeded` report carries `result`, an object checked against the capability; a `failed` report carries a non-empty string `reason`. Counts toward the job's output limit.

sequence.description: Grows with each report in an attempt. Resending a recorded sequence is a safe retry that records nothing.

JobReportAccepted.title: JobReportAccepted
JobReportAccepted.description: The report is recorded, or was already recorded under its sequence.

cancel_requested.description: True when the agent should stop and report `cancelled`.

lease_expires_at.description: When the lease expires: extended by a newly recorded report, unchanged by a replayed one, and null once the job finished.

LeasedJob.title: LeasedJob
LeasedJob.description: A job leased to the calling installation.

lease_token.description: Proves the lease on every report about this job.

not_after.description: After this time the job is no longer leased or retried.

output_limit_bytes.description: Budget for all report payloads, across every attempt.

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description: One point-in-time report: about the collector's host (`host` scope, the default), or from one of its collector modules about the targets it polls (`targets`) or the hypervisor it reads (`hypervisor`). The encoded body must be at most 256000 bytes. Unknown top-level fields are stored with the observation but not interpreted.

collector.description: Required for `targets` and `hypervisor` scope and not allowed for `host`. Names the collector module reporting, which Renga resolves to its own source within the installation. A collector's kind never changes.

id.description: The stable collector ID from the agent configuration. At most 64 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', and '-', starting and ending with a letter or digit.

complete.description: For `targets` and `hypervisor` scope: whether the report contains everything each reachable target holds, so a resource a target no longer reports can be withdrawn. Partial reports never withdraw anything.

hypervisor.description: For `hypervisor` scope, required: the hypervisor this report covers. An unreachable hypervisor reports no resources.

error.description: Why the target could not be reached. At most 255 characters.

id.description: A stable ID of the hypervisor. Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

status.description: Whether this report reached it. An unreachable target's resources stay as they were: unknown, never absent.

observation_id.description: Idempotency key chosen by the agent. Resending the same payload under the same key is a duplicate; a different payload under it is a conflict. Must not be blank; at most 255 characters.

observed_at.description: When the agent collected the data. At most 300 seconds in the future. An ISO 8601 date and time with a UTC offset, such as 2026-01-02T03:04:05Z.

resources.description: For `host` scope, exactly one `HostResource`: the host itself. For `targets` and `hypervisor` scope, any number of switches or VMs, possibly none.

scope.description: What the report is authoritative for. `host` (or omitted) for the host itself; `targets` from a `switch_poller` or `power_poller` collector; `hypervisor` from a `vm_provider` collector.

section_completeness.description: Marks sections the agent reports in full, so anything missing from them can be treated as gone rather than unknown.

targets.description: For `targets` scope, required: every target this report covers, each address once.

address.description: The target's configured address. Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

error.description: Why the target could not be reached. At most 255 characters.

status.description: Whether this report reached it. An unreachable target's resources stay as they were: unknown, never absent.

ObservationAccepted.title: ObservationAccepted
ObservationAccepted.description: The observation is stored. Reconciliation into inventory runs once inline; a failure there does not reject the observation, which stays stored for retry.

duplicate.description: True when this observation ID was already stored with the same payload.

errors.description: Why reconciliation failed, keyed by field or stage.

matched_resource_id.description: The inventory resource a host observation matched, when known. Absent for scoped reports, which list `resources` instead.

resources.description: For a scoped report: how each of its resources reconciled, in report order.

resource_id.description: The inventory resource it matched or created.

ObservationQueue.title: ObservationQueue
ObservationQueue.description: Health of one of the agent's on-disk queues. Drop counts cover the agent's current run; the backlog itself survives restarts. Unknown fields are ignored.

dropped_earliest_age_seconds.description: How long ago the earliest entry dropped for space or age was queued. Omitted until one is dropped.

dropped_latest_age_seconds.description: How long ago the latest entry dropped for space or age was queued. Omitted until one is dropped.

oldest_age_seconds.description: Age of the oldest queued entry, or null when nothing is queued.

PowerSource.title: PowerSource
PowerSource.description: Whether the agent can read one power source on its host (RFD 10, "Source status").

source.description: The source, such as `hwmon` or an exporter's URL. Must not be blank. At most 255 characters.

Rejected.title: Rejected
Rejected.description: Why a request was refused. Each error names the offending field with a dotted path such as `resources.0.interfaces.2.mtu`.

observation_id.description: The stored observation that already uses this observation ID (idempotency conflicts only).

status.description: Absent when authentication failed before the payload was read.

SourceIdentity.title: SourceIdentity
SourceIdentity.description: The reporting source. Optional: the intake key and installation ID already identify it.

kind.description: `host_agent` for a host report, or the collector's kind for a scoped report.

source_id.description: Omit, or send null. These endpoints reject any value, including the collector's own source ID or name.

duplicate.description: True when the source already accepted this replay ID with this batch.

samples.description: What became of the samples. Absent for a duplicate, whose samples were settled when it was first accepted.

rejected.description: Timed implausibly far in the future.

superseded.description: Not newer than their series' value, so kept out of it.

TelemetryBatch.title: TelemetryBatch
TelemetryBatch.description: A versioned batch of timed readings (RFD 10, "Measured history"), apart from inventory observations. Accepting one never renews the installation's lease, advances an inventory clock, or triggers reconciliation; the installation must have checked in first. The encoded body must be at most 512000 bytes. String limits count Unicode code points, and no string may contain a NUL character.

collector.description: The collector module whose readings these are, resolved to its stream as an observation's collector is. Omitted for the installation's own host readings.

id.description: The stable collector ID from the agent configuration, as for observations.

replay_id.description: Chosen by the agent and unique per source. Resending the same batch under it is a duplicate; a different batch under it is a conflict. Must not be blank; at most 255 characters.

items.description: One reading. Its series is the source's target, sensor, boundary, quantity, and window length; a series keeps the sample with the latest `event_at`, so a late replay never replaces a newer value. A sample whose `event_at` or window end is more than 5 minutes in the future is rejected. A well-formed sample that is not usable (`status` other than `valid`, a unit that does not fit its quantity, a negative value, or a power factor outside (0, 1]) is kept as invalid evidence, never as zero.

component.description: The power port or outlet on the target the sensor measures, by the name the target's hardware type gives it. Must not be blank; at most 255 characters.

coverage.description: For an aggregate, whether it covers everything at its boundary. An undeclared coverage is unknown.

event_at.description: When the reading was taken. An ISO 8601 date and time with a UTC offset, such as 2026-01-02T03:04:05Z.

fresh_for_seconds.description: How long after `event_at` the reading stays current, as its mapping declares.

leg.description: The three-phase leg. Required for, and allowed only on, `leg` readings.

mapping.description: The source mapping that produced the reading.

name.description: Must not be blank; at most 255 characters.

origin.description: `native` (the default) for the agent's own reading, `exporter` for one mapped from a local Prometheus exporter.

sensor.description: The sensor's stable identifier within its target, such as `outlet/3`. Must not be blank; at most 255 characters.

state.description: The reading of a `state` quantity, such as `on` or `failed`. At most 64 characters.

status.description: `valid` when omitted. A missing or failed reading carries no value.

target.description: The collector target the reading is about, such as a PDU's address. Required for a collector's readings and absent for the host's own. Must not be blank; at most 255 characters.

unit.description: Usable only as `apparent_power` in `VA`, `current` in `A`, `power_factor` in `1`, `real_power` in `W`, `voltage` in `V`; `state` takes none. At most 16 characters.

value.description: The reading of a numeric quantity.

window.description: The sampling window. An instantaneous reading starts and ends at once; any window lasts at most 86400 seconds. Windows of different lengths, to the millisecond, are different series.

end.description: Not before `start`. An ISO 8601 date and time with a UTC offset, such as 2026-01-02T03:04:05Z.

start.description: An ISO 8601 date and time with a UTC offset, such as 2026-01-02T03:04:05Z.

401.description: The intake key or installation header is missing or invalid, or the key changed while the request was in flight.

409.description: The installation ID is registered to a different collector source.

post.description: Renews the collector's lease and stores its capabilities and metadata. The first check-in from an installation registers the collector.

parameters.description: The collector installation's stable UUID. Within the intake key's organization it selects the collector, registering one on first use, so one key can enroll a whole fleet.
parameters.name: x-renga-installation-id

get.description: Tells an agent which deployment to send its authenticated requests to (RFD 23). A deployment is its own home, so it answers with its configured public URL whatever identifier is asked for. A resolver serving the same request at a well-known address looks the identifier up instead. The request carries no credential.

parameters.description: The deployment identifier read from the intake key's prefix, or empty when the key has none.
parameters.name: deployment

post.description: Leases up to `limit` queued `observe` jobs for the calling installation whose capability it listed, and offers privileged jobs within the same limit for it to claim with a signature (RFD 13). The installation must have checked in first.

post.description: Records a numbered report on a job the installation holds and extends its lease. Resending a recorded sequence replays it without recording or extending anything. The response says whether cancellation was requested.
